## Market.supplyApy property

The market's current, instantaneous supply-side Annual Percentage Yield (APY). If interested in the APY at a specific timestamp, use `getSupplyApy(timestamp)` instead.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get supplyApy(): number;
```
